trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take the Ramada free theme park shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-30) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review your Disney World park tickets and plans for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab something at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack from a nearby 24-hour Walmart Supercenter (~1.5 miles from hotel) or vending machines at the hotel to save money on arrival night

day_by_day.notes: Upon check-in, ask the front desk for the free theme park shuttle schedule for the entire week. Purchase any remaining Disney tickets online in advance to save vs. gate prices. Set an early alarm for Day 2 to maximize park time. Walmart on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy is great for stocking up on snacks, water bottles, and sunscreen to save money throughout the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early (6:30 AM) and head to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Take the free hotel shuttle (confirm departure time at check-in). Arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM). Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane passes for top rides. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and then Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train before crowds build. Explore Cinderella Castle and Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — ride Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check app for timing, usually early afternoon). Take a mid-afternoon break at a shaded area or air-conditioned shop to escape the Florida heat.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Magic Kingdom fireworks show 'Disney Enchantment' (typically at 9:00 PM). This is a bucket-list experience included with park admission. Take the free hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat a hearty breakfast at the hotel or use snacks purchased from Walmart the night before to save money before entering the park
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable quick-service spots. Try the clam chowder or chicken sandwich (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — budget-friendly burgers, chicken, and hot dogs (~$12-16 per person). Eat before the fireworks show to secure a good viewing spot

day_by_day.notes: Bring refillable water bottles — Disney offers free ice water at any quick-service location. Wear comfortable shoes and apply sunscreen generously. June in Orlando is hot and humid (highs near 92°F) with afternoon thunderstorms possible — pack a small poncho. Arrive at the park 30 minutes before official opening for 'rope drop' to beat crowds on the most popular rides.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT via the free hotel shuttle. Arrive at rope drop (typically 9:00 AM). Start in World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Individual Lightning Lane in advance via app at 7:00 AM sharp — it sells out fast). Then experience Test Track and Mission: SPACE.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase — stroll through the international pavilions representing countries like Mexico, Norway, France, Japan, and more. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion. Browse the cultural exhibits and street performers. World Showcase opens at 11:00 AM. Take time to explore the beautiful EPCOT gardens and fountains.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Luminous The Symphony of Us' (check current show schedule on the app). The show is included with park admission and features stunning fireworks over World Showcase Lagoon. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast from hotel or pre-packed snacks before heading out
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — one of EPCOT's best value quick-service restaurants with rotating seasonal dishes, sandwiches, and salads (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Explore World Showcase for affordable international street food — try a crepe from France kiosk (~$8), tacos from Mexico (~$10), or a school bread from Norway (~$6). Mix and match for a fun, budget-friendly international dinner experience

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park — comfortable walking shoes are essential. The International Food & Wine Festival or Flower & Garden Festival may be running in June — check Disney's website for special kiosk food offerings which can be budget-friendly snacks. Stay hydrated throughout the day. The free hotel shuttle is your best transportation option — confirm return shuttle times.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Hollywood Studios via the free hotel shuttle. Arrive at rope drop. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run (standby line) and try to book Rise of the Resistance via Individual Lightning Lane at 7:00 AM on the app. Explore the immersive Star Wars land atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show times on app — great air-conditioned break). Ride The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster for thrill seekers. Watch the Fantasmic! show schedule for evening planning.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' incredible nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse, water screens, fireworks, and beloved Disney characters. It's included with park admission and is one of Disney's best live shows. Return to hotel via shuttle and rest up.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or pre-packed snacks from Walmart supplies
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of Hollywood Studios' most affordable and fun quick-service spots. Try the Totchos (tater tot nachos) or grilled cheese sandwich (~$10-14 per person)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — a budget-friendly quick-service restaurant with burgers, wraps, and international dishes (~$12-16 per person). Eat before Fantasmic! to get good seats early

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios tends to have the longest waits for Star Wars rides — arriving at rope drop is critical. Use the My Disney Experience app constantly to monitor wait times and grab Lightning Lane passes strategically. Fantasmic! seating fills up 45-60 minutes before showtime — plan accordingly. Check if a Fantasmic! dining package is worth it for reserved seating (usually not necessary for budget travelers if you arrive early).

day_by_day.morning: Visit Disney's Animal Kingdom — take the free hotel shuttle. Arrive at rope drop (typically 8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom often opens earliest). Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage first thing (most popular ride in the park — waits can exceed 2 hours later). Then ride Na'vi River Journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom — ride Expedition Everest in Asia, Kilimanjaro Safaris in Africa (best in morning or late afternoon for active animals), and DINOSAUR in DinoLand U.S.A. Watch the Festival of the Lion King show (check times — excellent air-conditioned entertainment). Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings (check current offerings on app). Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks — plan accordingly. Head back to hotel, rest, and do laundry if needed. Explore the hotel pool area for a relaxing evening.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel or snacks before park opens — Animal Kingdom's early opening means an early start
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue — one of Disney World's best quick-service restaurants with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating. Ribs, chicken, and pulled pork at reasonable prices (~$14-18 per person). Worth the slight splurge
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — Avatar-themed bowls with rice, noodles, or salad bases with protein choices. Healthy, filling, and relatively affordable (~$13-16 per person). Or head back to hotel early and cook a simple meal using Walmart groceries to save money

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the most outdoor-heavy park — sun protection and hydration are critical. June heat can be intense by midday. The park's natural beauty and animal exhibits are free to enjoy once inside. Kilimanjaro Safaris is best experienced in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active. This is a great day for families with younger children.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget-friendly break from Disney parks today to save money and recharge. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely hotel breakfast. Visit Old Town Kissimmee (free admission, ~2 miles from hotel) — a classic Florida attraction with shops, street performers, and a vintage Ferris wheel. Browse the unique shops and enjoy the nostalgic atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the nearby International Drive area via rideshare (~$10-12) or hotel shuttle if available. Visit ICON Park — the outdoor entertainment complex is free to walk around. Browse the shops and enjoy the atmosphere. Consider the free outdoor areas and people-watching. Alternatively, visit the nearby Premium Outlets on International Drive for souvenir shopping on a budget. Return to hotel by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxing evening at the Ramada hotel pool. Order pizza delivery (Domino's, Pizza Hut, or local pizzerias deliver to the hotel area — ~$15-20 for a large pizza feeding the family) or cook simple meals from Walmart groceries. Watch Disney movies or plan remaining park days. This rest day is essential for energy management during a week-long Disney trip.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or cook eggs and toast using a microwave/mini-fridge with Walmart groceries — significant savings
meals.lunch: Grab lunch at Old Town Kissimmee — try local food vendors or nearby fast food options on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (McDonald's, Subway, Wendy's all within walking distance of hotel for ~$8-10 per person)
meals.dinner: Pizza delivery to hotel room or a sit-down meal at Perkins Restaurant & Bakery (~1 mile from hotel) — a family-friendly diner with affordable breakfast-all-day options and comfort food (~$10-15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: This off-park day is strategically placed mid-trip to save money (no park ticket needed) and rest tired feet. Saturday is typically the busiest day at Disney parks — avoiding the parks today is both budget-smart and crowd-smart. Use this day to do laundry, recharge devices, review remaining park plans, and purchase any additional souvenirs from outlet stores at a fraction of Disney's in-park prices.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite Disney park for a final day — Magic Kingdom is recommended for its classic Disney magic and any rides you may have missed. Take the free hotel shuttle for an early arrival. Use the My Disney Experience app to maximize remaining Lightning Lane opportunities. Revisit favorite rides and experiences from earlier in the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon completing your Disney World bucket list — any rides, shows, or experiences not yet experienced. Visit the Disney Springs area (free admission, no park ticket required) if you prefer a more relaxed final afternoon. Disney Springs offers free entertainment, live music, unique dining, and shopping along the waterfront. Great for souvenir shopping with more affordable options than inside the parks.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening at Disney — if at Magic Kingdom, stay for the fireworks one last time for a magical send-off. If at Disney Springs, enjoy the free evening entertainment and grab a final Disney meal. Return to hotel via shuttle, pack bags, and prepare for departure. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic on a budget.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast — eat well before a long park day
meals.lunch: If at Magic Kingdom: Casey's Corner on Main Street U.S.A. — classic hot dogs and corn dog nuggets at some of the park's lowest prices (~$10-13 per person). A beloved Disney tradition. If at Disney Springs: Earl of Sandwich — one of the best value meals near Disney with gourmet sandwiches (~$8-10 per person)
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly on your final night — try The Boathouse at Disney Springs for a memorable waterfront dining experience (appetizers and shared plates can keep costs manageable, ~$20-25 per person) or keep it budget-friendly with Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs (~$10-14 per person) founded by Guy Fieri

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time and arrange luggage storage if your flight is later in the day. The free hotel shuttle may offer airport drop-off — confirm with the front desk. Leave time for any last-minute souvenir shopping at Disney Springs (more affordable than in-park stores). Budget tip: Disney's PhotoPass photos can be purchased as a package — consider Memory Maker if you want professional photos from the week. Overall budget summary: By using the free hotel shuttle daily, bringing snacks and water bottles, eating at quick-service restaurants, and taking one off-park day, a family of 4 can significantly reduce costs compared to a typical Disney vacation.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30. No morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit. No afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 on United Flight UA. Collect luggage, arrange ground transportation or use the hotel's free theme park shuttle service to reach Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review the week's park plans. Pick up any essentials at a nearby 24-hour Walmart Supercenter (approx. 5 min drive on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy).

meals.breakfast: N/A – In transit
meals.lunch: N/A – In transit / airport dining
meals.dinner: Grab a late-night bite at Denny's or IHOP near Kissimmee (both open 24 hours, within 2 miles of the hotel) – budget-friendly comfort food to wind down after travel.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light. Purchase Disney park tickets online in advance if not already done. Download the My Disney Experience app and link your tickets. Set an early alarm for Day 2 to maximize park time. Confirm shuttle schedule with hotel front desk upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Adventure – Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle for an early arrival (park opening, typically 9:00 AM). Head straight to Fantasyland and Tomorrowland to ride Space Mountain, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, and Peter Pan's Flight before crowds build. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically for top-tier attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom – Visit Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise, then Liberty Square for the Haunted Mansion. Take a midday break at the hotel if needed (shuttle runs regularly) or find a shaded spot in the park to rest and recharge during peak heat hours (1–3 PM).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening spectacular – watch the iconic 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically 9:00 PM). Enjoy the parade if scheduled. Depart via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the hotel or grab a pastry and coffee at Main Street Bakery inside Magic Kingdom (Casey's Corner area) – budget around $10–15 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – mid-range counter service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and sandwiches. Budget $15–20 per person.
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street, U.S.A. – a classic table-service option with burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes. Budget $25–35 per person. Make an advance dining reservation via My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable, breathable clothing – June in Orlando is hot and humid (highs around 90°F/32°C). Bring sunscreen, refillable water bottles, and a small poncho for afternoon thunderstorms. Arrive at the shuttle stop 15 minutes before departure time.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase & Food Exploration – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT for rope drop (typically 9:00 AM). Start in Future World (now called World Discovery & World Nature) to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines grow. Use Lightning Lane for Remy's Ratatouille Adventure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stroll through the World Showcase beginning at 11:00 AM when pavilions open. Explore international pavilions including Mexico, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), Japan, France, and the UK. Sample small bites and beverages from multiple countries – this is the heart of the EPCOT food experience. Check for any live cultural performances on the World Showcase stage.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule). Enjoy a final dessert or drink from a World Showcase kiosk while watching the show. Return via hotel shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel continental breakfast or pick up a croissant and coffee at the France Pavilion's Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie upon arrival at EPCOT – budget $8–12.
meals.lunch: World Showcase food crawl – sample dishes from 3–4 countries (Mexico: tacos, Japan: sushi rolls, Morocco: hummus platter). Budget $20–30 per person for a satisfying variety.
meals.dinner: Coral Reef Restaurant at EPCOT's The Seas pavilion – mid-range table-service with seafood and pasta dishes, featuring a stunning aquarium view. Budget $35–50 per person. Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large – comfortable shoes are essential. The World Showcase loop is approximately 1.2 miles. June often brings afternoon thunderstorms around 3–4 PM; seek covered pavilion areas during storms. Check the My Disney Experience app for current entertainment schedules.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience – Take the hotel shuttle for early park entry. Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at park open. Ride Rise of the Resistance (book boarding group or Lightning Lane immediately upon entry) and Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore Black Spire Outpost, interact with characters, and build a lightsaber at Savi's Workshop if budget allows (approx. $249.99 – optional splurge).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios – Ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land, then catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show. Visit the Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster for thrill seekers. Take a break during peak heat with the Muppet*Vision 3D show.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for 'Fantasmic!' – Disney's Hollywood Studios' iconic nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and spectacular water/fire effects (check current show times, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 45–60 minutes early for good seating. Return via hotel shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge – themed counter service with unique dishes like Ronto Wraps and Batuu-inspired breakfast items. Budget $15–20 per person.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land – popular counter service with grilled cheese sandwiches, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos. Budget $12–18 per person.
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – a unique mid-range table-service experience where you dine in retro cars watching classic sci-fi movie clips. Burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes. Budget $25–40 per person. Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks – arrive early and prioritize Rise of the Resistance. Lightning Lane Multi Pass is highly recommended for this park. Savi's Workshop requires a reservation and is a premium add-on. Check the app for show times and any character meet-and-greet schedules.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom – Safari & Avatar Experience – Take the hotel shuttle for early entry. Head to Pandora – The World of Avatar first thing: ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride – Lightning Lane strongly recommended) and Na'vi River Journey. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Kilimanjaro Safaris – Join the safari tour to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and rhinos in a naturalistic savanna setting. Best wildlife activity is in the cooler morning/early afternoon hours. Afterward, explore Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close animal encounters. Catch the 'Festival of the Lion King' live show – a Broadway-caliber performance.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Animal Kingdom's evening atmosphere – the park often stays open after dark with special lighting effects in Pandora (the bioluminescent plants glow beautifully at night). Catch the 'Tree of Life Awakenings' projection show on the iconic Tree of Life. Return via hotel shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the hotel or pick up a snack at Harambe Market near the park entrance upon arrival.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, protein options, and unique beverages. Budget $15–22 per person.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – mid-range table-service with Asian-fusion cuisine including Mandarin chicken, lo mein, and ahi tuna. Budget $25–40 per person. Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler. Bring insect repellent for outdoor trails. The park has extensive walking on natural terrain – sturdy shoes recommended. Check the app for safari wait times and show schedules.

day_by_day.morning: Rest & Resort Morning – Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning at the hotel. Take advantage of the hotel pool, recharge, and do laundry if needed. This is a planned recovery day mid-trip to prevent burnout, especially important for families with children. Browse Disney merchandise or plan any remaining souvenir shopping.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Take the hotel's free shuttle to Disney Springs (free admission). Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and browse unique shops. Enjoy street entertainment, live music, and the vibrant atmosphere. Check out the Aerophile balloon ride for aerial views of the resort (approx. $25 per person).
day_by_day.evening: Continue enjoying Disney Springs into the evening – catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and entertainment, or enjoy live music at one of the waterfront venues. The Springs comes alive at night with great ambiance along the waterfront.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or nearby Perkins Restaurant & Bakery on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy – classic American breakfast, budget-friendly at $10–15 per person.
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a fun, casual setting. Budget $15–20 per person.
meals.dinner: The Boathouse at Disney Springs – upscale-casual waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and classic American fare. Amphicar tours available. Budget $35–55 per person. Reserve in advance for this popular spot.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to enjoy Disney magic without a park ticket. Parking is free in the garages. The hotel shuttle may have limited Disney Springs service – confirm with the front desk or use a rideshare app (Uber/Lyft) as an alternative. Saturday can be very busy at Disney Springs.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a Favorite Park or Magic Kingdom Revisit – Based on the week's experiences, choose a favorite park for one final morning visit. Magic Kingdom is recommended for a farewell visit – catch any rides missed earlier in the week, meet Disney characters, and soak in the atmosphere of Main Street, U.S.A. one last time. Purchase any remaining souvenirs at the park.
day_by_day.afternoon: Checkout & Departure Prep – Return to the hotel by early afternoon. Check out of Ramada by Wyndham (standard checkout is 11:00 AM – request late checkout if needed). Pack, organize luggage, and arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before any flight departure for travel time and airport security.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando – Head to Orlando International Airport. Enjoy a final Florida meal at the airport or a nearby restaurant before your flight. Reflect on an incredible week at Walt Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Magic Kingdom (if revisiting) for a themed breakfast experience – Budget $35–45 per person. Alternatively, grab a quick breakfast at the hotel before checkout.
meals.lunch: Casey's Corner on Main Street, U.S.A. in Magic Kingdom – classic hot dogs and corn dog nuggets, a beloved Disney tradition. Budget $12–18 per person. Or dine near the airport if departing early.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport – Kona Café or local options in the terminal. Budget $20–30 per person depending on flight time.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm hotel checkout time and any luggage storage options if your flight is in the evening. The hotel may offer luggage storage so you can enjoy the morning park visit without your bags. Use the My Disney Experience app to capture any final PhotoPass memories. Download all Disney photos before leaving – they expire after 45 days. Safe travels!

experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase featuring 11 international pavilions where you can sample authentic cuisines from countries like Japan, France, Mexico, and Italy. Enjoy cultural performances, artisan demonstrations, and signature rides like Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure. A perfect blend of food, culture, and entertainment.
experiences.location: EPCOT, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios Star Wars Experience
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the ultimate Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge experience at Disney's Hollywood Studios. Pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, survive the epic Rise of the Resistance ride, and build your own custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop. Also enjoy Toy Story Land and the thrilling Tower of Terror for a full day of entertainment.
experiences.location: Disney's Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day
experiences.description: Spend a fun-filled day at Disney Springs, Disney World's free-admission entertainment and shopping district just minutes from Kissimmee. Enjoy live street performances, visit the LEGO Store, dine at world-class restaurants like The Boathouse or T-REX Cafe, and catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater. Great for a budget-friendly family day out.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes roaming freely. Then journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the awe-inspiring Flight of Passage ride and the Na'vi River Journey. End the day with a live Finding Nemo musical show, making it a perfect blend of nature, culture, and family entertainment.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight UA arrives at 22:30. No morning or afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take the hotel's complimentary theme park shuttle or a pre-booked private car transfer to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room. Order a late-night room service spread or grab a quick premium bite at a nearby 24-hour spot like Denny's or IHOP on Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy to refuel after travel.

meals.breakfast: N/A – In transit
meals.lunch: N/A – In transit / airport dining (e.g., The Bubbalou's or airport lounges)
meals.dinner: Late-night arrival meal: Room service at the hotel or nearby IHOP / Denny's on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy for a relaxed, no-fuss late dinner

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange a private luxury car or shuttle pickup from the airport for a seamless arrival. Confirm hotel check-in details in advance since arrival is late. Lay out park tickets, Lightning Lane passes, and the next day's plan before sleeping. Hydrate well and get maximum rest — the parks await tomorrow!

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Adventure – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Use the hotel's free theme park shuttle departing ~8:00 AM. Start with Tomorrowland: ride Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin using pre-booked Lightning Lane Multi Pass to skip queues. Head to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (book Individual Lightning Lane in advance). Capture iconic photos in front of Cinderella Castle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration. Experience Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Enjoy the Festival of Fantasy Parade at 3:00 PM from a premium viewing spot near Main Street U.S.A. Take a mid-afternoon break at the air-conditioned Emporium or relax at a shaded seating area with a Dole Whip from Aloha Isle.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular TRON Lightcycle / Run ride at dusk, then secure a prime spot on the Main Street U.S.A. hub for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular (typically ~9:00 PM). This is one of Disney's most breathtaking nighttime shows — not to be missed on your first full day.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel before shuttle departure — grab grab-and-go pastries and coffee from the hotel lobby or a quick sit-down at Perkins Restaurant & Bakery nearby on Irlo Bronson Hwy
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom, Fantasyland) – A premium table-service experience inside Beast's enchanted castle; reserve well in advance via My Disney Experience app. Try the French onion soup and braised pork.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table – Dine inside Cinderella Castle for a truly magical fine-dining experience with character meet-and-greets. Book 60 days in advance. Enjoy prime rib, lobster bisque, and decadent desserts with castle views.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and Individual Lightning Lane selections for Space Mountain and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train at 7:00 AM via the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable, breathable clothing — June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Bring a portable fan, sunscreen SPF 50+, and a refillable water bottle. The hotel shuttle schedule should be confirmed the night before.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience. Take the hotel shuttle for an early arrival (~8:30 AM). Head straight to Galaxy's Edge and ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (book Individual Lightning Lane immediately upon park entry). Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore the immersive Black Spire Outpost — interact with droids, sip blue or green milk at Oga's Cantina, and browse Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (reservation required, ~$250/person — a premium must-do).
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to the rest of Hollywood Studios. Ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land. Experience The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check daily schedule). Take a mid-afternoon cool-down break with a Joffrey's iced coffee or a frozen lemonade.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the awe-inspiring Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime fireworks and projection show at Hollywood Studios (typically ~9:30 PM). Arrive 30 minutes early for a prime viewing spot near Echo Lake. Return to the hotel via shuttle feeling like a true Jedi.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge, Hollywood Studios) – A Star Wars-themed quick-service spot with surprisingly elevated dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Chicken Tip Yip. Grab a Ronto Wrap from Ronto Roasters for an authentic Galaxy's Edge breakfast experience.
meals.lunch: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant (Hollywood Studios) – A unique table-service restaurant where you dine in vintage cars under a starlit sky watching classic sci-fi movie clips. Try the Angus beef burger or the plant-based options. Reserve in advance.
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby (Hollywood Studios) – Disney's most prestigious Hollywood Studios restaurant, inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood hotspot. Order the signature Cobb Salad prepared tableside, pan-seared salmon, or the filet mignon. Excellent wine list available.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building requires a reservation and costs approximately $249.99 per lightsaber — book via My Disney Experience 60 days in advance. Oga's Cantina also requires reservations and has a 2-drink minimum per person. June heat is intense by midday — plan indoor experiences between 12:00–2:00 PM. Wear Star Wars-themed attire for extra immersion and great photos!

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase & Food Exploration – Arrive at EPCOT at rope drop (~9:00 AM via hotel shuttle). Begin in Future World / World Discovery: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane — secure your spot at 7:00 AM). Experience Test Track and Mission: SPACE (Orange Mission for the full centrifugal experience). Head to World Nature to ride Soarin' Around the World with Lightning Lane.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon leisurely strolling the World Showcase Lagoon (opens 11:00 AM). Sample authentic cuisine and beverages from at least 5–6 international pavilions: sip sake in Japan, enjoy a crepe in France, taste a Guinness in Ireland, grab a school bread in Norway, and sip a margarita in Mexico. Browse artisan shops and catch live cultural performances. Don't miss the stunning Remy's Ratatouille Adventure ride in the France Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Witness the breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule — typically ~9:00 PM). Secure a premium lagoon-side viewing spot at least 45 minutes early. End the evening with a nightcap at La Cava del Tequila in the Mexico Pavilion.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons (EPCOT, The Land Pavilion) – A bright, airy quick-service spot with fresh, healthy options including grain bowls, rotisserie chicken, and fresh-baked pastries. Great for a light, energizing park breakfast.
meals.lunch: World Showcase progressive lunch — graze across multiple pavilions: Katsura Grill (Japan) for teriyaki, Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie (France) for a croque monsieur and éclair, and Tangierine Café (Morocco) for a lamb shawarma platter.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (EPCOT, France Pavilion) – EPCOT's most upscale fine-dining restaurant, a tribute to legendary chef Paul Bocuse. Enjoy classic French haute cuisine: foie gras, bouillabaisse, duck confit, and a spectacular cheese board. Exceptional wine pairings available. Reserve 60 days in advance — this is one of Disney's hardest reservations to get.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is perfect for adults and older children who appreciate culture, food, and international experiences. For younger children, prioritize Remy's Ratatouille Adventure and Frozen Ever After (Norway Pavilion). The park is large — wear the most comfortable walking shoes you own. A mid-afternoon rest at the hotel is optional if energy levels dip; the hotel shuttle runs regularly.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom – Safari & Avatar Experience. Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM) for the best wildlife sightings on Kilimanjaro Safaris. Animals are most active in the cooler morning hours — spot lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, rhinos, and more on this 18-minute open-vehicle safari through a stunning 110-acre savanna. Follow up with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for up-close gorilla and bird encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enter Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (Individual Lightning Lane — book at 7:00 AM; this is the most in-demand ride at Disney World). Experience Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning boat ride. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora and enjoy the unique food and beverage offerings at Satu'li Canteen. Also visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR and Primeval Whirl, and catch the Festival of the Lion King show (check schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Experience the magical transformation of Pandora at night — the bioluminescent plants glow brilliantly after dark, creating an otherworldly atmosphere unlike anything else at Disney World. Catch the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular if available (check current schedule). End with a leisurely stroll through Discovery Island before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom, Discovery Island) – Disney's most acclaimed Animal Kingdom restaurant, inspired by the travels of Disney's Imagineers. Enjoy a premium breakfast or early lunch with dishes like whole-fried sustainable fish, braised short rib, and artisan charcuterie boards. Stunning artwork and decor throughout.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Animal Kingdom, Pandora) – A surprisingly elevated quick-service restaurant with healthy, customizable bowls featuring grains, proteins, and vibrant sauces inspired by Na'vi culture. Try the Cheeseburger Steamed Pod or the Slow-Roasted Rongi Bowl.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Return for dinner if you didn't dine here at breakfast, or enjoy a premium dinner at Yak & Yeti Restaurant (Animal Kingdom, Asia) for pan-Asian cuisine including Kobe beef, crispy honey chicken, and mango pie. Alternatively, head back toward Kissimmee for dinner at Capa Steakhouse at Four Seasons Resort Orlando for a world-class steak dinner with Magic Kingdom fireworks views.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8:00–9:00 PM) — plan accordingly. June heat is most intense here due to the outdoor, jungle-like environment. Carry extra water and electrolyte packets. Insect repellent is recommended near the safari and trail areas. Avatar Flight of Passage is a must — do not miss it. The park's lush landscaping provides more natural shade than other Disney parks.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Start your morning with a relaxed, leisurely breakfast without rushing to a park. Head to Disney Springs when it opens (~10:00 AM) via the hotel shuttle. Explore the vibrant waterfront shopping and entertainment district. Visit the LEGO Store for an interactive build experience, browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and check out the NBA Experience or Splitsville Luxury Lanes for family fun.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy the wide variety of entertainment at Disney Springs. Catch a live street performance or musician along the waterfront promenade. Visit the Coca-Cola Store rooftop for complimentary beverage tastings with panoramic views. Browse art galleries, luxury boutiques (kate spade, Pandora, Alex and Ani), and specialty shops. If traveling with children, the LEGO Imagination Center and Bibbidi Bobbidi Boutique (book in advance) are premium highlights. Optionally, use this afternoon for a return visit to a favorite park or to relax at the hotel pool.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a spectacular evening at Disney Springs with dinner at one of its flagship restaurants, followed by a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 with DINE-IN Theatres or live entertainment at House of Blues. Alternatively, use this evening for a return visit to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any missed experiences or to re-ride favorites.

meals.breakfast: The BOATHOUSE (Disney Springs) – A nautical-themed upscale restaurant on the waterfront. Enjoy a premium brunch with lobster eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, fresh-squeezed juices, and mimosas while watching the vintage amphicars cruise the water. One of Disney Springs' finest dining experiences.
meals.lunch: Morimoto Asia (Disney Springs) – Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant. Indulge in dim sum, Peking duck, sushi platters, and the signature Morimoto Bao Buns. The dim sum brunch on weekends is exceptional and highly recommended.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando (Disney Springs) – A chic, upscale steakhouse with a vibrant atmosphere. Order the 40-day dry-aged bone-in ribeye, truffle fries, and lobster mac & cheese. Excellent craft cocktail program and an impressive wine list. Perfect for a premium, celebratory dinner night.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter — no park ticket required. Parking is also free in the multi-level garages. This is an ideal day to recharge before the final park day. If any family members need a break from theme parks, Disney Springs offers a full day of entertainment without the intensity of a full park visit. Book all restaurant reservations well in advance, especially for The BOATHOUSE and STK Orlando on a Saturday evening.

day_by_day.morning: Grand Finale – Return to your favorite park or explore any missed experiences. Recommended: Return to Magic Kingdom for any rides not yet experienced (Tron Lightcycle / Run, Peter Pan's Flight, or the new Tiana's Bayou Adventure). Alternatively, revisit EPCOT for a final World Showcase stroll and any missed pavilions. Use this morning to collect final souvenirs, take last photos in front of iconic landmarks, and soak in the Disney magic one final time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely afternoon wrap-up. If checking out today, store luggage at the hotel's bell desk and enjoy a final Disney Springs visit for last-minute souvenir shopping and a relaxed lunch. Alternatively, spend the afternoon at the hotel pool — the Ramada Kissimmee Gateway has pool facilities perfect for a relaxing final afternoon. Begin packing and preparing for departure.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a premium Orlando restaurant near Kissimmee or on International Drive. Arrange private car or hotel shuttle to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic, world-class dining, and unforgettable family memories.

meals.breakfast: Grand Floridian Café (Disney's Grand Floridian Resort, accessible via Disney monorail from Magic Kingdom) – A beautiful, Victorian-inspired restaurant serving an exceptional character breakfast or standard breakfast with eggs Benedict, lemon ricotta pancakes, and fresh-squeezed orange juice. A luxurious final Disney breakfast.
meals.lunch: Final park lunch at your chosen park — splurge on a table-service meal at a restaurant you haven't yet visited, such as Coral Reef Restaurant (EPCOT, with underwater aquarium views) or 50's Prime Time Café (Hollywood Studios) for a fun, nostalgic experience.
meals.dinner: Christini's Ristorante Italiano (Dr. Phillips area, Orlando) – One of Orlando's most celebrated fine-dining Italian restaurants, perfect for a farewell dinner away from the parks. Enjoy handmade pasta, osso buco, and an extensive Italian wine list in an elegant, romantic setting. Alternatively, dine at Capa Steakhouse at Four Seasons Resort Orlando for a rooftop farewell dinner with Magic Kingdom fireworks views — the ultimate luxury send-off.

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) and arrange late checkout if needed for an additional fee. Confirm return transportation to Orlando International Airport well in advance — allow at least 3 hours before your flight for check-in and security. Purchase any remaining Disney souvenirs at Disney Springs or the hotel gift shop. Download all Disney PhotoPass photos from My Disney Experience before leaving — photos expire after 45 days. Consider purchasing Memory Maker for unlimited digital downloads of all on-ride and PhotoPass photos (~$199) — it's excellent value for a 7-day trip.
